input: Overnight lane 2 (plans, drawings and cut sheet) of shed-designer quality pass: DXF check, dimensions vs model, legible printing, marks, cutting-stock optimizer vs lower bound.
task: shed-designer lane 2: plans, drawings and cut sheet quality

doc_friction.issue: the hook blocks a whole compound Bash command (edit + commit + push) on the pre-edit state, so a fix in the same command never runs; split the fix from the push

goal: Correct, legible plans and an exact cut list for shed-designer
notes: PR #11311: cut optimizer solves the cutting-stock LP by column generation; over 51 designs / 257 cut lists orders fall $36,041.76 -> $35,766.03 and the shown bound rises $33,648.81 -> $35,614.35 (gap 7.1% -> 0.4%; 171 proven optimal). Brute force on 60 small cases: new optimal 60/60, old 55/60, bound never above optimum. Side effect: default auto overhang 9" -> 6" (9" now costs $2.87 more in 2x6). Summary now compares cut-sheet cost, not lumber with spares, with the bound. Checks: run_venture_tests shed-designer pass; typecheck 0 diagnostics; check_post_frontmatter pass. Audit (read-only, before #11268 merged) also found: plans/cut sheet/build prints were blank (print CSS hid <main>), overall wall dims under the title block, rafter cut-length dim drawn 1.8" short, roof line wrong on connector seats, only 11/33 marks lettered on sheets; fixes follow in later PRs. ezdxf 1.4.5 audit of the DXF from all 7 presets: 0 errors. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: all run: steps passed except pages.yml's two built-site checks, which fail locally only because its 'Build the site' step is skipped there (no _site); GitHub CI is the check of record for those. Second PR #11314 (plans fixes + plans.test.mjs) opened alongside. PR #11311 merged. PR #11314: plans print (was blank), fit the page, rafter long-point dim, connector-seat roof line, every mark lettered; plans.test.mjs 7 tests, 6 fail on main; venture tests 97 pass after merging main. PR #11314 merged. Third PR: cut sheet groups identical boards (printed cut sheet 6 -> 2 pages, checked by PDF page count in headless Chromium), cut colours print, trim offcut allows kerf, CSV grouped, site-built door step names its marks; lane report docs/reports/shed-designer-overnight-lane2.md. Tried iterated LP rounding: $32 over 257 lists at up to 240 ms each, not shipped.
